name: rosetta-arithmetic-integer
code:
use IO.Std.write
use IO.Std.write_line
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.StringSplitOptions

write("a b: ")

if let entered = read_line() then
    let fields =
        entered.split([' '], StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)

    let a = int.parse(fields[0])
    let b = int.parse(fields[1])

    write_line("sum: {a + b}")
    write_line("difference: {a - b}")
    write_line("product: {a * b}")
    write_line("quotient: {a / b}, truncated towards zero")
    write_line("remainder: {a % b}, signed like the first operand")

    let power = System.Math.pow(cast(a), cast(b))

    write_line("exponentiation: {power}, from the library")

    let (quotient, remainder) = System.Math.div_rem(a, b)

    write_line("divmod: {quotient} remainder {remainder}")
fi

use IO.Std.write
use IO.Std.write_line
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.StringSplitOptions

write("a b: ")

if let entered = read_line() then
    let fields =
        entered.split([' '], StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)

    let a = int.parse(fields[0])
    let b = int.parse(fields[1])

    write_line("sum: {a + b}")
    write_line("difference: {a - b}")
    write_line("product: {a * b}")
    write_line("quotient: {a / b}, truncated towards zero")
    write_line("remainder: {a % b}, signed like the first operand")

    let power = System.Math.pow(cast(a), cast(b))

    write_line("exponentiation: {power}, from the library")

    let (quotient, remainder) = System.Math.div_rem(a, b)

    write_line("divmod: {quotient} remainder {remainder}")
fi
